stories.title: Presidi, 'tetto stranieri condivisibile ma difficile da applicare'

en.title: Headmasters, 'cap on foreigners understandable but difficult to implement'
en.summary: A headmasters' representative suggests that while a limit on foreign students may be conceptually acceptable, implementing it based on school proximity presents practical challenges.

stories.title: Tetto agli stranieri in classe, il capo dei presidi: “Difficile da attuare, alunni vanno accolti”

en.title: Cap on foreigners in class, head of headmasters: 'Difficult to implement, students must be welcomed'
en.summary: The headmasters' leader questions the feasibility of restricting foreign students, asking whether schools should refuse enrollment based on neighborhood demographics.

stories.title: Lega, Salvini annuncia Congresso straordinario: "Torno per chiedere la fiducia della mia famiglia"

en.title: League, Salvini announces extraordinary congress: 'I return to ask for my family's trust'
en.summary: The League party leader announced an extraordinary congress, stating he would address party members about internal dissent and criticism of what he characterizes as leftward concessions.

stories.title: Salvini, domani proporrò Congresso straordinario a ottobre

en.title: Salvini, tomorrow I will propose extraordinary congress in October
en.summary: Salvini plans to propose an extraordinary party congress in October to seek confidence from party members.

stories.title: Baldissero d'Alba, spara contro i ladri e ne uccide uno: indagini sulla dinamica

en.title: Baldissero d'Alba, shoots at thieves and kills one: investigation into circumstances
en.summary: A group of 4 or 5 people broke into a construction site in Baldissero d'Alba. The property owner's son heard noises, retrieved a legally-held firearm, and fired, killing one intruder; he acted out of fear.

stories.title: Baldissero d’Alba, sorprende ladri nel cortile, spara e ne uccide uno: aperto fascicolo per omicidio

en.title: Baldissero d'Alba, surprises thieves in courtyard, shoots and kills one: murder investigation opened
en.summary: A man fired shots in darkness at thieves discovered in a farmyard during a nighttime burglary attempt, killing one intruder. He then called police and is now under investigation for homicide.

stories.title: Lega, Salvini: “Ora un congresso straordinario per confermarmi alla guida. Poi tutti zitti”

en.title: Lega, Salvini: "Now an extraordinary congress to confirm me as leader. Then everyone quiet"
en.summary: Salvini announced plans for an extraordinary party congress to reconfirm his leadership of the Lega. He also endorsed Silvia Sardone as the centre-right candidate for Milan.

stories.title: Baldissero d’Alba, scopre i ladri in cortile e spara: un morto

en.title: Baldissero d'Alba, discovers thieves in courtyard and shoots: one dead
en.summary: A man discovered burglars in his courtyard near Grinzane Cavour, retrieved a firearm, and fired shots in darkness, killing one intruder. He contacted police and is being investigated for homicide.

stories.title: Scuola, Meloni: “Tetto agli stranieri in classe e burqa vietato”. I presidi: “Difficile da applicare”

en.title: School, Meloni: "Cap on foreigners in class and burqa banned". Principals: "Difficult to implement"
en.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced plans to introduce a burqa ban in schools and cap foreign students in classrooms, though school principals expressed concerns about implementation challenges.

stories.title: Germania: due Land al voto, Merz si gioca tutto. Sale l’affluenza

en.title: Germany: two states vote, Merz plays for everything. Turnout rises
en.summary: Elections are taking place in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania with polling stations open since early morning, with higher voter participation reported.

stories.title: Germania, voto a Berlino e Meclemburgo Pomerania: la Cdu rischia il tracollo, Merz in bilico

en.title: Germany, voting in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: CDU risks collapse, Merz under pressure
en.summary: The German chancellor's party risks losing ground and being excluded from regional parliaments in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, intensifying pressure on Merz with speculation about potential successors and governing alternatives.

stories.title: Baldissero d’Alba, spara e uccide il ladro nel cortile di casa. Il vicino: “Ha fatto bene”. Salvini: “Lo abbraccio”

en.title: Baldissero d'Alba, shoots and kills thief in his yard. Neighbor: "He did right". Salvini: "I embrace him"
en.summary: A 35-year-old truck driver shot and killed a thief on his property and is under investigation for homicide, while the League leader expressed support for his actions.

stories.title: Dal coworking alle case: Wao scommette sugli affitti flessibili

en.title: From coworking to homes: Wao bets on flexible rentals
en.summary: Wao, a company offering flexible rental options ranging from one night to one year for apartments, is expanding its business model beyond coworking spaces.

stories.title: «Silva Lab One”, laboratorio intelligente per gestire il bosco dei Monti Alburni

en.title: Silva Lab One, intelligent laboratory to manage the forest of Monti Alburni
en.summary: Silva Lab One is the first Natural Forest Laboratory established in the southern foothills of Monti Alburni within Cilento National Park, utilizing satellite technologies to manage the forest ecosystem.

stories.title: Purina investe 50 milioni sul sito di Portogruaro

en.title: Purina invests 50 million at Portogruaro site
en.summary: Purina's Portogruaro facility, marking its 40th anniversary, announces a new development phase with investment of 50 million euros for production of dry pet food for dogs and cats.

stories.title: «Revisione delle regole europee priorità per restare competitivi»

en.title: Review of European rules a priority to remain competitive
en.summary: Italian ceramic industry faces barriers to competitiveness despite European support, with first-half data from Confindustria Ceramica showing increased ceramic tile exports yet regulatory obstacles persist.

stories.title: Val di Fiemme e Cembra: autunno culturale, enogastronomico e wellness

en.title: Val di Fiemme and Cembra: cultural, gastronomic and wellness autumn
en.summary: Val di Fiemme and Cembra tourism boards have developed an autumn programme featuring indoor and outdoor activities plus events to attract visitors during off-season months.
